name: Saviano (Italy)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Saviano (arrows and a wreath, drawn in yellow outline) within branches, with the date 1867 on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Saviano, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Saviano arms — arrows and wreath in yellow outline, crowned, within branches, with scroll 1867
